title.zh: 【USDGO 将集成至 Copper ClearLoop，支持机构场外结算与托管】
title.en: 【USDGO 将集成至 Copper ClearLoop，支持机构场外结算与托管】

current_state.zh: OSL Group announced that its regulated enterprise stablecoin USDGO will be integrated into Copper's ClearLoop network, allowing institutional clients to hold USDGO in Copper custody accounts and trade and settle across connected exchanges without moving funds out of custody.
current_state.en: OSL Group announced that its regulated enterprise stablecoin USDGO will be integrated into Copper's ClearLoop network, allowing institutional clients to hold USDGO in Copper custody accounts and trade and settle across connected exchanges without moving funds out of custody.
